name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 12 – Am 57
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 12a. Underlines the failure of Union policies in preventing migration flows and human trafficking; reiterates its concerns about the role played by the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund (AMIF), which should guarantee the proper implementation of a rigorous asylum policy in accordance with international standards, while blocking illegal migration and ensuring border controls and an adequate repatriation policy;
